people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

translations.web: They didn’t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
translations.bsb: They did not turn aside from the king’s command regarding the priests or the Levites in any matter, including that of the treasuries.
translations.kjv: And they departed not from the commandment of the king unto the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
